title: NCERT Class XII Physics chapter 3 weblink panel - a QR code carrying the code 12089CH03, which opens the chapter's supplementary material.
note: Carried as a spec so the shard is complete and the judgement is on record, but nothing here should replace the scan. The only readable content is the printed code beneath the matrix, and that is all the redraw contains.
unreadable: the QR matrix itself - a 2-D barcode is a bitmap of about 1500 modules whose values cannot be recovered reliably from the crop; a redrawn approximation would be a code that does not scan, which is worse than the scan it replaced
this is not a physics figure at all - it carries no quantity, no geometry and no label a question can turn on, so the right outcome is to leave the panel to its scan
